title: Bad extension fiber bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $n$ sign variables, and let $w$ be a natural number such that the width of $\varphi$ is at most $w$. For every coordinate restriction $\eta$, the number of bad restrictions whose designated bad extension is $\eta$ is at most $w$.
hypotheses_covered: A disjunctive normal form on those coordinates
A natural number $w$ bounding the formula width
